snippet.title: Two Point Hospital: Full Health Collection | Coming to Consoles on September 16th!
snippet.description:
Behold the Full Health Collection, bringing you Two Point Hospital and ALL the DLC in one easy to swallow bundle! This complete collection of DLCs offers you a wealth of new locations, new hospitals, new items, new gameplay and more!

The Full Health Collection is launching digitally on PlayStation 5, XBOX Series X|S and Nintendo Switch 2 on 16th September 2026.

The Full Health Collection is releasing physically for PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch 2 on 6th November 2026. We’ll share more details about where, which regions, and how to preorder physical as soon as possible.

For the first time ever on consoles, cure a creative crisis in Culture Shock, aid anachronistic ailments in A Stitch in Time, and manage unorthodox ambulances in Speedy Recovery, introducing 9 new hospitals to manage, new gameplay mechanics, and over 80 new illnesses to cure - and that's not all! The Full Health Collection also includes Bigfoot, Pebberley Island, Close Encounters & Off the Grid expansions PLUS a booster of free items, including the Retro Items Pack, Fancy Dress Pack, and more!

It’s time to build, cure and improve in style.

To see more Two Point news and info, join us at:
